theorems.name: M5Authority.bind_eq_ok
theorems.claim: A bind that returns ok came from an ok computation and an ok continuation.

theorems.name: M5Authority.owner_eq
theorems.claim: The generated OwnerContext equality returns exactly whether the owners are equal.

theorems.name: M5Authority.checkpoint_eq
theorems.claim: The generated Checkpoint equality returns exactly whether the checkpoints are equal.

theorems.name: M5Authority.bytes_allM
theorems.claim: Element-wise byte comparison over equal-length lists decides list equality.

theorems.name: M5Authority.bytes_eq
theorems.claim: The modeled Vec<u8> equality returns exactly whether the byte vectors are equal.

theorems.name: M5Authority.constraints_eq
theorems.claim: The generated Constraints equality decides structural equality.

theorems.name: M5Authority.operation_eq
theorems.claim: The generated OperationContract equality decides structural equality.

theorems.name: M5Authority.description_eq
theorems.claim: The generated PlanDescription equality decides structural equality.

theorems.name: M5Authority.plan_eq
theorems.claim: The generated Plan equality decides structural equality, so the exact-plan check is exact.

theorems.name: M5Authority.claim_eq
theorems.claim: The generated WitnessClaim equality decides structural equality.

theorems.name: M5Authority.clone_bytes
theorems.claim: Cloning a modeled byte vector returns the same vector.

theorems.name: M5Authority.plan_clone
theorems.claim: The generated Plan clone returns the same plan.

theorems.name: M5Authority.quota_position_matches
theorems.claim: The generated quota scan terminates with ok, and any located record carries the plan quota identity at the authority checkpoint.

theorems.name: M5Authority.attempt_record_ok
theorems.claim: The attempt lookup accepts exactly an owned, present, same-generation attempt key.

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_refuses_a_started_attempt
theorems.claim: Starting an already-started attempt returns AlreadyStarted and leaves the authority unchanged.

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: Every start refusal returns the unchanged authority.

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_marks_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: A successful start marks exactly the presented unstarted attempt, counts one protected operation and leaves witnesses, quotas and the profile unchanged.

theorems.name: M5Authority.started_attempt_cannot_start_again
theorems.claim: Attempts start at most once: replaying the execution permit on the resulting state is refused without change.

theorems.name: M5Authority.invocation_eq
theorems.claim: The generated InvocationOutcome equality decides equality through the discriminant.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_owner
theorems.claim: The default owner inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_checkpoint
theorems.claim: The default checkpoint inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_plan
theorems.claim: The default plan inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_claim
theorems.claim: The default witness-claim inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_invocation
theorems.claim: The default invocation-outcome inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_source
theorems.claim: The default source inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.ne_trait_default_kind
theorems.claim: The default resource-kind inequality is the negated decision.

theorems.name: M5Authority.witness_record_found
theorems.claim: An accepted witness lookup is owned by the authority and returns the record at the claimed slot.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_presented_claim
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a presented witness whose claim equals the requested claim.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_a_live_witness
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a live retained witness at the claimed slot.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_exact_plan
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a retained witness whose plan equals the requested plan.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_valid_facts
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only validated facts and returns their supplied quota snapshot.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_the_current_checkpoint
theorems.claim: Fact validation accepts only facts at the authority checkpoint.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_current_authority
theorems.claim: Fact validation requires a pending invocation, the owner, the authority source, a grant of exactly the plan, valid credentials, no revocation, the plan policy, the validity window and an accepted quota check.

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_quota_bounds_the_charge
theorems.claim: The quota check accepts only a charge within the supplied snapshot; an existing checkpoint-local record must carry that same snapshot.

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: A refused quota charge returns the unchanged authority.

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: A refused commit returns the unchanged authority.

theorems.name: M5Authority.refused_admission_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: Denial and preflight leave witnesses, attempts and quota records unchanged; only their request counter and requested effect move.

theorems.name: M5Authority.push_ok
theorems.claim: A successful modeled Vec push appends exactly the pushed element.

theorems.name: M5Authority.index_mut_ok
theorems.claim: A successful modeled mutable index reads the indexed element and writes back by replacement at that index.

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_keeps_the_rest
theorems.claim: A successful quota charge changes no field other than the quota records.

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_charges_the_plan_units
theorems.claim: A successful quota charge adds exactly the plan units to the located record, or opens a record for this checkpoint holding the supplied snapshot and exactly those units.

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_consumes_the_claimed_witness
theorems.claim: A successful commit marks exactly the claimed witness slot consumed.

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_registers_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: A successful commit appends exactly one unstarted attempt bound to the requested plan and keyed by the returned permit.

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_charges_the_plan_quota
theorems.claim: A successful commit applies exactly the quota charge of the requested plan.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_path
theorems.claim: A committed admission validated the entry and committed on the same request-recorded state, whose ledger fields are the caller’s.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_presents_the_claim
theorems.claim: A committed admission required a presented witness carrying exactly the requested, authority-owned claim.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_binds_the_exact_plan
theorems.claim: Admitted execution stays bound to the independently authorized plan: the retained witness and the current grant both carry exactly the requested plan.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_the_current_checkpoint
theorems.claim: Stale facts cannot mint an execution permit: committed admission requires facts at the authority checkpoint.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_current_authority
theorems.claim: Committed admission requires a pending invocation, owner, authority source, valid credentials, no revocation, the plan policy and the validity window.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_consumes_one_live_witness
theorems.claim: Each consumed witness corresponds to one admitted attempt: committed admission consumes exactly the claimed, previously live witness.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_registers_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: Committed admission registers exactly one unstarted attempt bound to the requested plan.

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_charges_within_the_supplied_quota
theorems.claim: Committed admission charges exactly the plan units to this checkpoint record for the plan quota, which carries the supplied snapshot, and the charge stays within it.

theorems.name: M5Authority.admission_preserves_quota_within
theorems.claim: Every admission outcome preserves the checkpoint-local quota invariant.

theorems.name: M5Authority.authorize_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Authorization never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.advance_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Checkpoint advancement never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Execution start never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.observe_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Observation never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_witness_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Witness retirement never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_live_witnesses_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: The generated live-witness retirement loop terminates and never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.cancel_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Invocation cancellation never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.fail_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Invocation failure never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.deliver_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Success delivery never writes a quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_opens_no_quota
theorems.claim: A newly constructed authority has no quota record.

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_starts_within_quota
theorems.claim: Initialization: a new authority satisfies the quota invariant.

theorems.name: M5Authority.step_preserves_quota_within
theorems.claim: Preservation: every public state-returning transition preserves the quota invariant.

theorems.name: M5Authority.reachable_quota_within
theorems.claim: Over every finite serialized prefix of public transitions from Authority.new, each checkpoint-local quota record stays within its supplied snapshot.
